title: End the spring promotion: member free minutes back to 30
author: kasia.brandt
body:
## Change

Reverts the promotional free-minutes window back to the standard 30 minutes at the front of a member's ride.

## Testing

Pricing e2e case for the standard window re-enabled and passing.

comments.author: dana.whitlock
comments.body: For the record, the promotion itself ran 2026-02-20 through 2026-06-10.
